text: Jules requires access to your repositories to operate
quote: Jules needs access to your repositories in order to work.

text: Assign a coding task to Jules directly from a GitHub issue using the 'jules' label
quote: Use the "jules" label in an issue to assign a task directly in GitHub.

text: Jules runs in a VM, cloning the repo, installing dependencies, and modifying files itself
quote: Jules runs in a virtual machine where it clones your code, installs dependencies, and modifies files.

text: Jules generates an implementation plan that you can review and approve before code changes happen
quote: Once you submit a task, Jules will generate a plan. You can review and approve it before any code changes are made.

text: Jules automatically detects and uses an AGENTS.md file in the repo root for context
quote: Jules now automatically looks for a file named AGENTS.md in the root of your repository.

text: You get notified when a task finishes or needs your input
quote: You’ll be notified when the task completes or needs your input.

text: Jules produces a diff of changes you can browse and approve
quote: Jules provides a diff of the changes. Quickly browse and approve code edits.

text: Jules creates a pull request of its changes that you can approve, merge, and publish
quote: Jules creates a PR of the changes. Approve the PR, merge it to your branch, and publish it on GitHub.

text: A public API lets you build custom workflows, automate bug fixing/code review, and embed Jules into other tools
quote: You can use the API to create custom workflows, automate tasks like bug fixing and code reviews, and embed Jules's intelligence directly into the tools you use every day

text: You can create and manage API keys (up to 3 at a time) from the web app settings
quote: In the Jules web app, go to the Settings page to create a new API key. You can have at most 3 API keys at a time.

text: An automationMode API field controls whether a PR is auto-created after a task, off by default
quote: The `automationMode` field is optional. By default, no PR will be automatically created.

text: Plan tiers define daily task and concurrency limits for power users and agent-heavy workflows
